findings.reason: a worker following "one entry per kind" cannot satisfy the exactly-once assertion on any stacked aggregation+population name the density family composes, and SPEC says implement as written, so the node would be blocked or would silently ship a double render.
findings.text: §7 tells the worker to place the total-density sentence "in one conditioned entry per kind" — `aggregation: [total]` for `total_electron_density` and `population: [thermal, fast]` for `thermal_electron_density`/`fast_electron_density` — but the parser's segments are a superset test (`set(entry.segments) <= segments`, `imas_standard_names/grammar/terms.py:334`) and the condition kinds stack, so `total_thermal_electron_density` parses to `aggregation=total + population=thermal` (verified: base `density`, segments `['aggregation','physical_base','population','subject']`). That name matches both conditioned entries, so under §6 ("a `note`: one sentence rendered after the documentation opening of every name that selects the entry") both notes render and the sentence appears twice, failing §7's own "each name it describes renders it exactly once". §6 only asks for a precedence rule between a conditioned entry and an unconditioned sibling, so no rule resolves two conditioned entries both matching

findings.reason: §7's measure rests on a control that cannot go red for one of its three sentences, so the node's evidence for the triangularity case would report safety it does not provide; the plan needs a discriminating control for that sentence (or a stated per-family control).
findings.text: §7 declares the test "fails again with a sentence moved to its family's shared template", but for the triangularity sentence this control is silent: the unconditioned triangularity template selects every triangularity name (`set([]) <= segments`), and §6 itself records that "a sentence about the unqualified triangularity reaches `upper_triangularity_of_plasma_boundary`", so moving that sentence to the shared template still places it on exactly the names §7 says it describes (`triangularity_of_plasma_boundary`, upper and lower forms). The test therefore passes and the guard is never shown to fire
